design: INDIVIDUAL 12: a tall lean elderly female council arbiter with slate-grey spotted skin and a broad long cranium, an aged four-mandibled face with a slightly uneven lower tusk, silver scalp tendrils tied into a high compact bundle. A fitted plum long vest over a pale wrap skirt with a short geometric bronze shoulder cape and a pendant made of two concentric squares. Holds a small closed council case in one hand and an exposed smooth teal token in the other, comparing them.
